scripts.build: tsc -b && vite build && npm run build:functions
scripts.build:functions: esbuild netlify/handlers/*.mts --bundle --platform=node --target=node20 --format=esm --outdir=netlify/functions --out-extension:.js=.mjs --log-level=warning --banner:js="import { createRequire } from 'node:module'; const require = createRequire( import.meta.url );"
scripts.test: firebase emulators:exec --only auth,firestore --project demo-ease-my-life "node --test tests/payments/functions.test.ts && playwright test --config tests/playwright.config.ts"
scripts.test:account: firebase emulators:exec --only auth,firestore --project demo-ease-my-life "playwright test --config tests/playwright.config.ts --project 'account-*'"
scripts.test:rules: firebase emulators:exec --only firestore --project demo-ease-my-life "playwright test --config tests/playwright.config.ts --project rules"
